mapper.sql: (CASE WHEN #{ugrndOn} AND b.ugrnd_res = 1 THEN #{ugrndW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{gosiwonOn} AND b.sp_type = '고시원' THEN #{gosiwonW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{rooftopOn} AND rt.bld_id IS NOT NULL THEN #{rooftopW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{violOn} AND b.viol_yn = '1' THEN #{violW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{oldOn} AND b.useapr_day IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(b.useapr_day) = 8 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(LEFT(b.useapr_day, 4) AS UNSIGNED) >= #{oldYears} THEN #{oldW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{floodOn} AND b.flood_cnt >= #{floodCnt} THEN #{floodW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{lowOn} AND b.elev_m <= #{lowElev} THEN #{lowW} ELSE 0 END)
(CASE WHEN #{cheapOn} AND b.price_pct IS NOT NULL AND b.price_pct <= #{cheapPct} THEN #{cheapW} ELSE 0 END)

SELECT b.* , pt_ugrnd , pt_gosiwon , pt_rooftop , pt_viol , pt_old , pt_flood , pt_low , pt_cheap , score , CASE WHEN b.useapr_day IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(b.useapr_day) = 8 THEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(LEFT(b.useapr_day, 4) AS UNSIGNED) END bld_age FROM building b
WHERE 1 = 1

CONCAT_WS(' · ', IF(t.pt_ugrnd > 0, '지하층', NULL), IF(t.pt_gosiwon > 0, '고시원', NULL) , IF(t.pt_rooftop > 0, '옥탑', NULL), IF(t.pt_viol > 0, '위반건축물', NULL) , IF(t.pt_old > 0, '노후', NULL), IF(t.pt_flood > 0, '침수', NULL) , IF(t.pt_low > 0, '저지대', NULL), IF(t.pt_cheap > 0, '저가', NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT sgg_cd, emd_nm, AVG(lat) lat, AVG(lng) lng, COUNT(*) cnt FROM building GROUP BY sgg_cd, emd_nm ORDER BY sgg_cd, emd_nm
SELECT sgg_cd, lng, lat FROM building
SELECT t.sgg_cd, AVG(t.lat) lat, AVG(t.lng) lng, COUNT(*) total, SUM(t.score >= #{scoreMin}) risk_count FROM () t GROUP BY t.sgg_cd ORDER BY t.sgg_cd

SELECT FLOOR(t.lng / #{cell}) ix , FLOOR(t.lat / #{cellLat}) iy , COUNT(*) size , AVG(t.lng) lng , AVG(t.lat) lat , SUM(t.score >= #{scoreMin}) risk_count , MAX(t.score) max_score , SUM(t.score >= 80) h_red , SUM(t.score >= 60 AND t.score < 80) h_orange , SUM(t.score >= 40 AND t.score < 60) h_yellow , SUM(t.score < 40) h_green , MIN(t.lng) min_lng, MIN(t.lat) min_lat, MAX(t.lng) max_lng, MAX(t.lat) max_lat , MAX(t.bld_id) one_bld_id, MAX(t.bld_nm) one_bld_nm, MAX(t.addr) one_addr, MAX(t.use_nm) one_use_nm FROM (
AND b.lat BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND b.lng BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng} ) t GROUP BY ix, iy

SELECT b.bld_id, b.lat, b.lng, b.bld_nm, b.addr, 0 score , DATE_FORMAT(MAX(vh.visited_at), '%Y-%m-%d') checked_at FROM visit_history vh JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = vh.bld_id WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY b.bld_id, b.lat, b.lng, b.bld_nm, b.addr

SELECT t.bld_id, t.sgg_cd, t.emd_nm, t.addr, t.bld_nm, t.use_nm, t.grnd_flr, t.ugrnd_flr, t.lat, t.lng , t.score, t.bld_age , t.pt_ugrnd, t.pt_gosiwon, t.pt_rooftop, t.pt_viol, t.pt_old, t.pt_flood, t.pt_low, t.pt_cheap , factor_text FROM (
AND (b.addr LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR b.bld_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')) ) t WHERE t.score >= #{scoreMin} ORDER BY
t.bld_age DESC, t.score DESC t.addr ASC t.score DESC, t.bld_age DESC, t.bld_id
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.* , factor_text , (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(vh.visited_at), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM visit_history vh WHERE vh.bld_id = t.bld_id) checked_at , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN vulnerability_list l ON l.vulnerability_id = f.vulnerability_id WHERE f.bld_id = t.bld_id AND l.is_active = 1 AND l.user_id = #{userId}) archive_cnt FROM (
AND b.bld_id = #{bldId} ) t
